t: This is Bellenden Road, a shopping and residential street in Peckham, in south London. The wider area around it, tucked between Peckham, Camberwell and East Dulwich, is known as Bellenden. The name goes back to William Bellenden, the first Lord Bellenden, who lived from 1604 to 1671. He was a Scottish politician and served as Treasurer-depute of Scotland, and his name is the one the street carries.
